definitions.gloss: reserved seating; seat reservation; seat designation
definitions.explanation: A system where specific seats are assigned in advance, as opposed to free seating.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{座席指定|ざせきしてい}です。
{座席指定|ざせきしてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a reserved seat ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{座席指定|ざせきしてい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This movie theater has reserved seating, so it's better to book popular showings early.

notes:
{座席指定|ざせきしてい} means reserved seating as opposed to free seating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {座席指定|ざせきしてい}{券|けん} (reserved seat ticket)
- {座席指定|ざせきしてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to choose one's seat when booking)

USAGE:
- Common on shinkansen, limited express trains, concerts, movies
- Opposite of ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧ (non-reserved seating)
- "All seats reserved" is usually {全席指定|ぜんせきしてい}, without ⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧: reserved seat
- ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧: non-reserved seat
